messages:
Marina: Quick question about the Console authoring flow for routing configs — specifically header-based overrides + tenant presets. Should the YAML editor auto-expand presets into the file, or keep them as references and show previews? Trying to avoid surprise overrides at deploy time.
Ajay: I'd lean toward references + preview. If we inline presets users might accidentally edit the canonical preset copy. Preview panel that shows resolved config seems safest. :thinking_face:
Sophie: +1 to preview. Also we need a way to run the same resolver locally in CI so tests match Console. Otherwise authors will see different behavior in UI vs CI.
Yusuf: On the schema side, if we keep refs we need a stable $ref resolution algorithm. We should lock resolution order (tenant -> route -> override) and document it. Also we need to signal if there are circular refs.
Marina: Good point — can we add a non-blocking warning for circular refs in the editor and a blocking error in CI? That would let authors save drafts but fail deploys.
Leah: For telemetry, surface a metric for "resolved override count" per deploy so we can see how often presets are being applied vs explicit fields. It'd help debug unexpected behavior.
Ajay: Proposal: Console shows the compact authoring YAML with references. Right-hand pane is resolved view (read-only). Save action persists user YAML only. When user clicks "Apply preset inline" in the pane we generate an explicit transform that appears in a changelog entry.
Sophie: For tests: add a test harness command `tools/route-resolve --input=foo.yaml --presets=presets/` that outputs resolved JSON. We can CI-assert exact token order for critical headers.
Yusuf: I sketched a minimal JSON schema to validate references. Putting as pseudo in chat:
```
"properties": {
  "rules": { "type": "array" },
  "presets": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "$ref": "#/definitions/preset" } }
}
```
We also validate that `rules[*].headers` keys match allowed header-name regex.
Marina: Nice. Can infra-bot run the resolver on save and post results? Even just a quick lint would catch bad refs.
infra-bot: ran resolver on draft 1751023345: 2 warnings, 0 errors. Warnings: preset `eu-rate-limit` overridden by route `internal-proxy`. See /console/drafts/1751023345/preview
Leah: Also: UX tiny thing — highlight lines in the resolved view that differ from source so users can jump to the references. Diff-highlighting prevents surprise.
Ajay: Implementation notes: backend will expose /resolve-config POST that accepts {yaml, tenantId, presetsVersion}. Deterministic behavior requires pinning presetsVersion in drafts.
Sophie: Test matrix: minimal unit tests for resolver logic + end-to-end that uploads a draft via Console and then calls /resolve-config and compares to `golden/*.json`. Add a flaky-tolerance flag for non-deterministic ordering only for non-functional fields.
Yusuf: I'll PR a new schema + resolver implementation. Will include circular ref detection and an explicit error code `RESOLVE_CIRCULAR`.
Marina: Perfect — next steps: Yusuf to open PR, Ajay to sketch Console UX mockup, Sophie to add CI harness change, Leah to add telemetry event proposal. I'll collect these as TODO in the thread. Thanks all :raised_hands:
